# Source Organization Instructions

Use these rules when adding, moving, renaming, or validating raw or derived
source files and their manifest entries:

- [Categories and naming](references/source-naming.md): category keys,
  topic paths, source and derived filenames.
- [Manifest and moves](references/source-manifest.md): `sources.json` fields,
  path constraints, validation, coordinated moves.

Read both references for new sources or moves. For a manifest-only correction,
read the manifest reference and confirm its paths against the naming reference.
